name: +1 Speed Raft Escape
desc:
🌊 Welcome to +1 Speed Raft Escape! 🛶

How to Play:
🛶 Every move makes your raft faster!
🌊 Navigate dangerous rivers, currents, and obstacles to earn wins!
⚡ Unlock powerful rafts with insane speed boosts!
🔥 Rebirth to unlock new perks and push your speed even further!

Can you conquer the rivers and reach max speed?

👍 If you’re having fun, don’t forget to like the game!
